recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — say what you multiply and divide by, and which part of the working is the geometric series.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Take out 7/9 and write each term as 1 minus a power of 1/10
steps.margin_note: First mark. The ×(7/9) move is the method mark. Write the bracket as 1 minus a power of one tenth before summing anything.
steps.memory_tip: Nine times 0.1 is 0.9, and 0.9 is 1 − 0.1, which is why 9 is the number to bring in.

recall.must_convey: That 7/9 is taken out so each term becomes 1 minus a power of 1/10.
accept: take out seven by nine to turn point seven into point nine
write each term as one minus a power of one tenth
seven by nine bayataki teesi, one minus one tenth power ga rayali
the given terms are not in G P so they must be rewritten

steps.why: Multiplying and dividing by 9 turns 0.1, 0.11, 0.111 into 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, and each of those is 1 minus a power of 1/10. That is what makes a geometric series appear, because the terms as given are not in G.P. at all.
common_mistakes: Treating 0.7, 0.77, 0.777 as a G.P. and dividing 0.77 by 0.7 to look for a ratio.
Taking out 7/10 instead of 7/9, which leaves 1, 1.1, 1.11 and still no G.P.

steps.label: Sum the geometric part
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Both pieces must appear: the n from the ones, and the finite G.P. sum. Either boxed form is a complete answer.
steps.memory_tip: n ones minus a shrinking G.P., all multiplied by 7/9.

lines.text: (the n ones add to n; the fractions are collected)

recall.must_convey: That the n ones give n and the rest is a finite G.P. of ratio 1/10, giving Sₙ = (7/81)[9n − 1 + (1/10)ⁿ].
accept: the ones add to n and the rest is a G P with ratio one tenth
use the finite sum formula a into one minus r to the n over one minus r
the answer is seven by eighty one into nine n minus one plus one by ten to the n
n ones plus G P sum, seven by eighty one bayata untundi
check with n equals one and you get point seven

steps.why: The n ones add to n, and what is left is a finite G.P. of ratio 1/10. Putting n = 1 gives (7/81)(9 − 1 + 0.1) = 0.7, the first term, which is a quick check on the answer.
common_mistakes: Using the infinite sum a/(1 − r) when the question asks for n terms.
Losing the n and writing only the geometric part as the answer.
